crisis_alerts.title: US Supreme Court asked to restore abortion pill access
crisis_alerts.summary_en: The US Supreme Court is being asked to restore access to the abortion pill mifepristone after a lower court limited its mail-order distribution.

crisis_alerts.title: EU: Parliament Confirms That ‘Only Yes Means Yes’
crisis_alerts.summary_en: The European Parliament in Italy adopts a resolution emphasizing consent as the key factor for rape legislation across EU.

crisis_alerts.title: Abortion Pills Still Widely Available by Mail in the U.S., Despite Fifth Circuit Ruling
crisis_alerts.summary_en: The Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals in the United States imposes a nationwide ban on mail-order dispensation of mifepristone for abortion by clinicians after telehealth consultations.

crisis_alerts.title: Trump’s Budget Plunders Birth Control and Reproductive Health Programs—With Open Derision for Americans Who Need Them
crisis_alerts.summary_en: President Trump's proposed budget for 2027 threatens to eliminate Title X family planning and reproductive health services nationwide in the United States, using language that openly mocks those who rely on these programs.

crisis_alerts.title: SCOTUS Clears the Way for Anti-Abortion CPCs to Continue Dodging Accountability
crisis_alerts.summary_en: The Supreme Court's decision allows anti-abortion clinics to continue avoiding state oversight and regulation, potentially leading to substandard care.

crisis_alerts.title: MBA student raped by shopkeeper who entered her room to deliver groceries: Police
crisis_alerts.summary_en: An MBA student in an unspecified location was raped by a shopkeeper who entered her room under the pretense of delivering groceries.

crisis_alerts.title: Connecticut lawmakers pass bill to ban female genital mutilation
crisis_alerts.summary_en: Connecticut lawmakers have passed a bill to ban female genital mutilation (FGM), marking significant progress in the protection of bodily autonomy and women's rights.

crisis_alerts.title: Q&A with Qamar Naseem from Blue Veins Pakistan on child marriage and the latest bill passed by the Punjab Assembly
crisis_alerts.summary_en: The article discusses the issue of child marriage in Pakistan and highlights a recent bill passed by Punjab Assembly aimed at addressing this human rights concern.

crisis_alerts.title: From Colombia to Connecticut: The urgent need to end FGM in the Americas
crisis_alerts.summary_en: The article highlights the critical need to end Female Genital Mutilation (FGM) in Colombia and Connecticut as a matter of urgency for bodily autonomy.

crisis_alerts.title: El Sinaloa de Rocha Moya tiene el índice más alto de feminicidio a nivel nacional
crisis_alerts.summary_en: The article highlights a high rate of femicide in Sinaloa, Mexico, and mentions potential extraditions for officials.

crisis_alerts.title: Rape-murder of 3-year-old: Kin seek death, protest shuts down Pune district
crisis_alerts.summary_en: A three-year-old girl's rape and murder in Pune have led to public outrage, protest shutdown of the district, with demands for justice including a death sentence.

crisis_alerts.title: Abortion pill fight heads to Supreme Court as manufacturer warns of ‘chaos’ after ruling
crisis_alerts.summary_en: The Supreme Court is set to decide on an emergency request from Danco Laboratories after a ruling blocked mail-order access for abortion pills and reinstated in-person prescription requirements.

crisis_alerts.title: What to know about a mifepristone maker asking the Supreme Court to restore access to the pill by mail
crisis_alerts.summary_en: A mifepristone manufacturer seeks Supreme Court intervention to restore mail-order access following an appellate court ruling that restricted this method of obtaining the abortion pill.

crisis_alerts.title: A mob hit in Ireland, a 10-year manhunt and an arrest in Dubai
crisis_alerts.summary_en: Daniel Kinahan's arrest in Dubai marks a significant breakthrough after a decade-long manhunt by Irish authorities.
